data.Title: 8468P - Enforcement Tow Operator and Secure Storage Services
data.Description:
The City of Richmond is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced service providers to deliver enforcement towing services within its municipal boundaries. The selected proponent will be responsible for providing safe, timely, and professional towing, impoundment, and related support services in alignment with City bylaws, regulatory requirements, and operational standards.

The City is committed to maintaining public safety, ensuring efficient traffic flow, and supporting bylaw compliance through responsive and effective enforcement towing services. Proponents are expected to demonstrate their ability to provide reliable service delivery, maintain appropriate equipment and facilities, and adhere to high standards of customer service, transparency, and accountability.

The City encourages proponents to outline their operational capacity, response times, fleet capabilities, and experience working with municipal or enforcement agencies, as well as their approach to handling sensitive or complex towing situations.

data.Title: 8610P - 25CHA03 - City Hall Annex First Floor Tenant Improvements - Construction Services
data.Description: The City of Richmond (the "City") is seeking to engage a qualified General Contractor (the “Proponent”) to provide construction services for the City Hall Annex First Floor Tenant Improvements (the "Project") at 6900 Minoru Boulevard, Richmond, British Columbia.

data.Title: 8604Q - Supply and Delivery of (1) 21-23 Passenger Shuttle Bus Low Floor Shuttle Bus
data.Description:
The City of Richmond (the “City”) is proposing to purchase one (1) minimum 6,500KG cutaway van with dual rear wheels (the “Requirements”), as described in the Contract Documents.

Primary application for vehicle act as a mobile workshop, for the Flood Protection Department, and to carry personnel and materials and towing of various trailers.
 

The unit shall incorporate features that provides for ease of operation and maximum safety for the public and operator and environmental considerations for reduction of emissions and environmental impacts.  Other alternative fuels will be considered and evaluations of these features will be made and will contribute to the decision of the award.
